Your progress

The bar under each image type grows with every correct answer. A ship is mastered after 4 correct answers in a row. Your progress is stored in this browser only. Clearing all browsing data starts you from scratch.

How it works

  • You see an image and pick one of three ships.
  • What you got wrong comes back soon. What you know comes up less often.
  • The better you know a ship, the more similar the wrong answers get.
  • Keyboard: 1, 2, 3 to answer, Enter to continue.
